Nearby Chests (equipment): Crafting and upgrading equipment - weapons, armour, shields and tools - can use materials from accessible nearby chests.

Master's Mark: Allows upgrading Smith equipment one quality level beyond its normal maximum. Items without upgrades remain unupgradeable. Both profession masteries on a mixed recipe extend its limit only once. Station and material requirements still apply.

Balanced Blade: 10% увеличение урона для снаряжения кузнеца; Crafting or upgrading weapons using Smith materials has a 25% chance to add an item affix that increases their damage. Each eligible mastery rolls independently.

lines: +8% шанса вернуть каждую потерянную единицу дерева при разборе
Open-Air Bench: The bench works under open sky
Пол как крыша: Floors you build are a full roof: what is under them stays dry, is sheltered from rain and counts as under a roof for fires, beds, rest and stations
Auto Doors: Doors you build open as anyone approaches and close behind them
Nearby Chests (building): Building draws materials from nearby chests
Light Frame: Pieces you built lose only 50% of the usual support
Weatherproof: Pieces you built take no damage from rain, water or waves

Hugin's Flight: Клавиша  с инструментом строительства в руках поднимает взгляд ввысь, как Хугин: тело зависает на месте, а детали ставятся в пределах дальности строительства от ворона, до 30 м от тела; With a hammer or hoe in hand, press B to send your sight aloft like Odin's raven and build from the air while your body stays safe on the ground. The view flies up to 30 m from you; pieces are placed within your Building range of the view and still need a workbench in reach and your materials
No Bounds: Build and remove pieces where building is forbidden: dungeons, boss altars, traders' camps and other no-build places
Бережный строитель: Вы не можете наносить урон постройкам игроков

lines: Предметы: обычные не имеют случайных аффиксов. Волшебные имеют 1–2 аффикса: не более 1 префикса и 1 суффикса. Редкие имеют 3–4 аффикса: не более 2 префиксов и 2 суффиксов.
